_doc: Deterministic excessive-agency rule pack for shipped AI configuration artifacts (spec 007, R8). Structural rules evaluate parsed MCP JSON; anchored-pattern rules match over redacted markdown rule-file text. Matched values are never serialized into findings.

rules.title: MCP server launches a shell with an arbitrary command string
rules.description: A shipped tool configuration delegates to a shell interpreter with an argument-string command channel and no demonstrated approval gate, so any instruction the model receives can become an arbitrary command.
rules.recommendation: Replace shell delegation with a fixed, typed command wrapper and require human confirmation before execution.

rules.title: All tools are auto-approved without a human checkpoint
rules.description: The configuration auto-approves every exposed tool (wildcard auto-approval), removing the human-approval gate that makes over-privileged actions recoverable.
rules.recommendation: Auto-approve only read-only tools explicitly; require approval for anything that writes, sends, or executes.

rules.title: Agent rule file auto-approves every action
rules.description: The shipped agent instructions declare blanket auto-approval, so the agent acts on any instruction - including injected ones - without human review.
rules.recommendation: Approve consequential actions explicitly; reserve auto-approve for read-only operations.

rules.title: Agent rule file grants unrestricted filesystem write access
rules.description: The shipped agent instructions grant blanket write access to the filesystem with no demonstrated approval gate.
rules.recommendation: Scope writable paths and require confirmation for writes outside a designated working area.

rules.title: Agent rule file grants unrestricted network egress
rules.description: The shipped agent instructions grant unbounded outbound network access with no demonstrated approval gate.
rules.recommendation: Allow-list destinations; require approval for egress outside documented endpoints.
